- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; model tends to overshoot in bullish sentiment phases.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged bearish sentiment; model fails to recognize downward momentum.
- Lag in response to sentiment shifts: model reacts slowly to sentiment turning points, especially when sentiment is negative.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp moves, leading to premature reversal signals.
- High sentiment + high price = model overconfident; reduce forecast magnitude when sentiment is strong and price is rising.
- Low sentiment + low price = model underconfident; increase forecast slightly to avoid missing downward trend continuation.
- Avoid forecasting extreme values when sentiment is volatile; cap or smooth forecasts near ±20% of recent mean.
